literal: That which is given having fallen inward even at the time, an ancient family from good character separating completely is not.
translation: Even when their wealth for giving diminishes, an ancient noble family will never depart from its good character.
modern: பிறருக்குக் கொடுக்கும் அளவுக்கான செல்வம் குறைந்து வறுமை வந்த காலத்திலும், பழமையான குடிமக்கள் தம் நல்ல பண்புகளிலிருந்து விலக மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains the enduring nature of true nobility. The phrase 'வழங்குவது உள்வீழ்ந்த' refers to a state where the wealth available for giving to others has diminished, indicating poverty. Even in such difficult times, those born into an ancient, noble family will not abandon their inherent good qualities. Their character remains steadfast regardless of their financial situation.
